description:
.mdx pages map directly to the Markdown scanner in scripts/comment_syntax.py, meaning that top-level MDX import statements and JSX comments ({/* comment */}) outside fenced Markdown code blocks bypass the checker. Parse top-level MDX constructs with a JavaScript/TypeScript scanner or AST parser to inspect comments outside code fences.

PR #2821 meets the written acceptance, but its oracle review found two gaps: comments inside export/import statements are dropped silently (finding D3), and `{ /* x */ }` with whitespace inside the braces is missed. Only one .mdx file is tracked in the repository (a golden fixture), so the practical risk is low. Finish this item after #2821 merges.
